title: 第二章 望气之道！
slug: 分手后觉醒逆天改命系统
content_zh:
第(1/3)页

“是以万事万物，能望其气，便可知其运，能知其运，便可改其命…”

看着脑中知识，叶凡入了迷，对他来说，这等于开启一扇新世界的门。

时间飞快流逝，等叶凡感觉吃透脑中知识时，他醒过来。

一醒，他就发现一切都变了。

一切物品，在他眼里都散发出不同光泽。

比如房中家具，他能看见，这些家具都有着一股灰色微光。

叶凡知道，这表明这些家具已经老旧，再过段时间就会坏。

再比如外面行人，他们有的白光缭绕，有的白中带红，还有白中带灰的。

“按照望气术记载，白中带红，属小富，白中带灰，属诸事不顺，清淡白光，属平庸，是普通人。”

“而灰黑属死气，代表命不久矣…”

脑中划过念头，叶凡眼神越发明亮。

他没想到望气术这么玄妙，真能看到虚无气运。

这时，手机铃声响起。

叶凡看向手机。

看到上面时间，他脸色一变，他没想到他坐了一天！

他赶忙接通。

“叶凡，你在哪呢！不说好了今天八点半来盛宝楼报道么？现在到时间了，你怎么还不来！”

电话传出一道恼火声音，叶凡道，“对不起李主管，我睡过头了，正在路上，马上到。”

“赶紧的！我可不想挨陈总的骂！”

电话挂断，叶凡心中一紧，换身衣服，洗把脸冲出门。

他清楚，他现在没时间研究系统，他得保住工作，这关乎吃饭。

陈总名为陈若彤，名字普通，人一点不普通。

她出身泉城最著名的珠宝世家陈家，是陈家大小姐。

按道理，这种大家小姐一般都娇生惯养，性格泼辣。

她不同，不光没半点小姐脾气，为人还很低调。

她学习更极好，二十八岁，就已极优异成绩，在蓝国华盛顿大学取得矿物学，以及金融学博士双学位。

Page (1/3)

"So if you can see the aura of all things, you can know their destiny, and if you can know their destiny, you can change their destiny..."

Ye Fan was fascinated by the knowledge in his mind. For him, this was like opening a door to a new world.

Time passed quickly, and when Ye Fan felt that he had absorbed the knowledge in his mind, he woke up.

As soon as he woke up, he found that everything had changed.

All objects have a different luster in his eyes.

For example, he could see that the furniture in the room had a gray shimmer.

Ye Fan knew that this meant that the furniture was old and would break after a while.

Another example is the pedestrians outside. Some of them are surrounded by white light, some are white with red, and some are white with gray.

"According to the records of the fortune-telling technique, if the person is white with red, he or she is a little rich, white with gray means that everything is not going well, and light white means that he is mediocre, and he is an ordinary person."

"And gray and black are the energy of death, which means that your life is not long..."

Thoughts flashed through his mind, and Ye Fan's eyes became brighter and brighter.

He didn't expect that the Qi Watching Technique was so mysterious, that he could really see the void of luck.

At this time, the cell phone rang.

Ye Fan looked at the phone.

When he saw the time on it, his expression changed. He didn't expect that he had been sitting there all day!

He quickly answered.

"Ye Fan, where are you! Didn't you agree to report to Shengbao Tower at 8:30 today? It's time now, why don't you come!"

An annoyed voice came from the phone, and Ye Fan said, "I'm sorry, Director Li, I overslept. I'm on the way. I'll be there soon."

"Hurry! I don't want to be scolded by Mr. Chen!"

After hanging up the phone, Ye Fan felt nervous, changed his clothes, washed his face and rushed out.

He knew that he didn't have time to study the system now, he had to keep his job, and it was about eating.

Mr. Chen’s name is Chen Ruotong. He has an ordinary name but an extraordinary person.

She comes from the Chen family, the most famous jewelry family in Quancheng, and is the eldest daughter of the Chen family.

It stands to reason that this kind of lady is usually spoiled and has a fierce personality.

She is different. Not only does she not have the temper of a young lady, she is also very low-key.

She is even better at studying. At the age of twenty-eight, she has already achieved excellent results and obtained a double major in mineralogy and finance from the University of Washington, a blue country.
